# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network

clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase

inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous

medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

Who is the leading Veterinary API manufacturer in India?

Aarambh Life Science is a GMP-certified Veterinary API manufacturer in India, supplying high-quality
active pharmaceutical ingredients for animal healthcare applications worldwide.

Do you manufacture both Veterinary APIs and Human APIs?

Yes, Aarambh Life Science manufactures and supplies a wide range of Veterinary APIs and Human APIs
for pharmaceutical companies globally.

How do I choose a reliable API manufacturer in India?

When selecting an API manufacturer, consider GMP compliance, product quality, manufacturing
capabilities, regulatory standards, documentation support, and supply reliability. Aarambh Life
Science follows stringent quality practices and provides reliable API supply solutions for
pharmaceutical companies.

Is Aarambh Life Science a GMP-certified API manufacturer?

Yes, we follow GMP-compliant manufacturing processes and stringent quality standards to ensure
product safety and consistency.

Do you export APIs internationally?

Yes, we export Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to pharmaceutical companies, distributors, and
healthcare organizations across international markets.

Why source Veterinary and Human APIs from India?

India is a global hub for pharmaceutical manufacturing, offering high-quality APIs, GMP-compliant
production facilities, skilled expertise, and cost-effective supply solutions. Aarambh Life Science
supplies Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to domestic and international markets.

What quality documents are available with your APIs?

We provide relevant documentation including COA, specifications, and other quality-related documents
based on customer requirements.

How can I request a quotation for APIs?

You can contact our team through the inquiry form or Contact Us page to receive a customized
quotation for your API requirements.

## Delivering Excellence Through Science With Quality, Trust And Innovation.

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

Our broad range of intermediates such as fluoroquinolones and nitroimidazoles supports complex API
development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

We offer Salicylic Acid, Trimethylamine, Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride,
and Methyl Nicotinate.

### Amines

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

# We enable patients' independence

We are the pioneering leader in designing, developing, and manufacturing self-injection devices such
as autoinjectors.

## Get to know SHL Medical

### Why choose us

By producing the world's best autoinjectors, we empower millions of patients worldwide to be more
independent, 6.5 million to be exact. Our impact is even bigger: we benefit the entire healthcare
system by improving treatment results and reducing healthcare costs.

][162]
[
Our products

### Our products

We believe that people living with chronic conditions should not be defined by their diseases. That
is why we develop advanced drug delivery systems that help enhance self-injection.

### Our services

We provide full end-to-end solutions from device development to distribution, including final
assembly, labeling, and packaging services for our drug delivery devices.

Over the past year, we have reinforced our market leadership through world-class manufacturing
capabilities, expanded our global footprint, and embedded sustainability into every aspect of our
business, creating lasting value for customers, patients, and communities worldwide.

## At AIS Healthcare^{®}, we do what’s right—not just what’s expected. The results are
## life-changing.

AIS Healthcare is more than just a pharmacy or a nursing services provider. We are a healthcare
company committed to doing more of what matters. 

We have two divisions focused on providing highly effective treatments and support services to
patients with complex conditions, which allows us to improve their quality of life and enhance the
management of their health.

Our Advanced Infusion Care (AIC) division offers in-home immunoglobulin (Ig) and Alpha-1 therapy,
and access to the latest FDA-approved treatments in our infusion centers that treat a wide range of
health needs. We take a Center of Excellence approach to patient care with a team-based model that
prioritizes patient outcomes.

Our Targeted Drug Delivery (TDD) division provides patient-specific compounded medications and
services for individuals with surgically implanted intrathecal infusion pumps. With two fully
redundant state-of-the-art 503A compounding pharmacies, we meet or exceed industry standards to
produce medications of the highest quality.

We are proud to do more for patients and providers, exceeding expectations in everything we do.
Because when we do more to advance care quality, providers are empowered, and patients are
supported. Days get easier. **Lives get better.** * [Video Resources][1]

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

# Global Pharmaceutical Database

45,000+ verified **API manufacturers**, excipient vendors, and finished dosage form license holders
worldwide. Search by name, CAS, pharmacopoeia, or country — connect directly with verified
producers.

[Explore Full Database →][4]

### API Manufacturers List

Full profiles with DMF, GMP, CEP, and pharmacopoeia data. Includes direct emails and phone contacts
to verified suppliers.
* 45,000+ API entries
* Purity & compliance data
* Regional price ranges

[View API Manufacturers →][5]

### API Pricing Intelligence

Indicative price ranges for active ingredients by region (US, EU, Canada & other regulated markets,
and RoW). Use ranges for budgeting, supplier benchmarking, and negotiation baselines.
* Median & typical ranges per kg
* Linked to manufacturers & compliance flags
* Filter by grade, pharmacopoeia, GMP/DMF

[Check API Price Ranges →][6]

### Search Power

Find compounds by formula, name fragment, CAS number, or country. Narrow by GMP, purity, and
pharmacopoeia.
* Flexible query options
* Instant cross-filtering
* Global coverage

[Start Advanced Search →][7]

**Built for decision-makers.**
— QA, RA, and sourcing specialists who require verified global manufacturing intelligence.
— Executives planning launches or acquisitions in the FDF segment.
— Analysts and investors tracking CMC risk, pricing dynamics, and approval timelines.

### Excipients Vendors

Directory with functional category filters, regulatory notes, purity, and indicative pricing. Direct
access to vendors.
* Direct vendor contacts
* Regulatory data & purity
* Global price overview

[Explore Excipients →][8]

### Finished Dosage Forms (FDF)

Search by active ingredient, trade name, ATC, or therapeutic area. See country-level marketing and
license holders.
* License holder profiles
* Therapeutic class filters
* European market coverage

[Browse FDF Markets →][9]

### Data Integrity

Regulatory precision with transparent sources, manual verification, and traceability for each
record.
* Verified sources
* Update cadence
* Audit-ready fields

[See Compliance Signals →][10]

**ADE & OEL Reports on Demand.** We provide compound-specific *ADE (Acceptable Daily Exposure)* and
*OEL (Occupational Exposure Limit)* assessments authored by an experienced scientist. Request
datasets, sample reports, or the author’s CV: [support@api-fdf.com][11].

### Global Reach

All major regulatory markets covered: US, EU, Canada, Japan, Korea, and others. Export-ready
supplier visibility.
* Worldwide scope
* Regional pricing insights
* Regulatory compliance

### Custom Research

We conduct custom data searches and dossier compilation by therapeutic area, compound, or region.
* Tailored datasets
* API-FDF correlation studies
* Competitor mapping

Request via [mail@api-data.com][12]

### Support & Updates

Continuous data maintenance, responsive support, and dedicated research help for enterprise clients.
* Dedicated support
* Regular updates
* Enterprise data integration

[Visit Full API-FDF Platform →][13]

The Science

## Delivery is the
## *therapeutic*.

The pharmacological activity of a drug is only as good as its ability to reach the target tissue at
therapeutic concentration. We believe drug delivery engineering is not a formulation afterthought —
it is the central design variable that determines clinical success.

Our platforms are built around three first principles: **selectivity** (getting the payload to the
right cell type), **kinetics** (releasing it at the right rate), and **scalability** (manufacturing
at GMP standards from early IND through commercial supply).

Payload-agnostic architecture
Small molecules, biologics, nucleic acids, peptides
Proprietary safety engineering
Reduced off-target exposure by design, not by chance
Translational pharmacokinetics
In vitro–in vivo correlation validated across 6 species

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

Capsule is free to use. You only pay your copay on your medication.

Yes. Capsule accepts all commercial insurance plans, Managed Medicaid, and Medicare Part D. We'll
also coordinate directly with your insurance so you don't have to.

## Can all my doctors use Capsule?

Yes. Any doctor can send a prescription to Capsule.

## A Powerful Natural Biopolymer for Health and the Environment

The Science

### What Makes Chitosan Different?

**Chitosan** is a natural substance and a **biopolymer** derived from chitin. Chitin is the second
most abundant natural material after cellulose. It is a structural sugar found in shellfish shells,
insect exoskeletons, fungi and certain algae.

Unlike most naturally occurring sugars, chitosan can carry a **positive charge**. Many pathogens,
microplastics, dietary fats, heavy metals and other unwanted compounds are negatively charged.

+

This electrostatic difference allows chitosan to attract, bind or interact with many negatively
charged substances across biological and environmental systems.

This makes chitosan particularly valuable in antimicrobial systems, digestive-health formulations,
toxin-binding applications, water purification, agriculture and advanced biomedical materials.

Functional Benefits

Chitosan's polymer structure and ionic activity make it useful in several important health,
nutritional and environmental applications.

microbiome formulations for humans and animals.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?

# WHO-GMP Certified Sterile Injectable Manufacturer – Exporting Quality Globally

## Trusted CDMO & CMO Partner for Global Pharmaceutical Companies

Farbe Firma Pvt. Ltd. is a WHO-GMP-certified pharmaceutical company specializing in sterile
injectable formulations for international markets. Based in India and driven by world-class
manufacturing, we deliver ampoules, liquid vials, lyophilized vials, emulsions, and critical-care
products for partners worldwide.


With advanced manufacturing technology and high-capacity production lines, we deliver world-class
quality and reliability as a trusted CDMO/CMO partner for global pharmaceutical companies seeking
contract manufacturing excellence.

[Explore More ][15]

• Advanced, fully automated sterile production lines

• High-capacity output for global pharmaceutical demand

• Dedicated R&D for innovative injectable formulations

• Complete CDMO/CMO contract manufacturing services

• Regulatory-compliant export documentation support

## Our Manufacturing Capabilities

## Pharmaceutical Exporter Serving 30+ Countries Worldwide

Headquartered in India, Farbe Firma serves healthcare providers, distributors, and pharmaceutical
companies across Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America, and CIS countries. Our robust export
infrastructure includes:

• Complete regulatory documentation and dossier support
• International quality certifications (WHO-GMP compliant)
• Efficient logistics and cold-chain management
• Multi-lingual customer support team
• Flexible order quantities for global partners

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas

and development expertise.

partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your

Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business

## Global Innovative Medical Device Manufacturing and Design

During our 80-year legacy of cutting-edge medical device manufacturing and medical device
development, we have established a solid patient-focused foundation in cardiac rhythm, cardio and
vascular health, neuromodulation devices, and custom medical battery packs and chargers for global
OEMs. Integer is a world leader in advanced medical device design and outsourcing across four
continents. Our technology and manufactured components can be found in almost every global medical
device brand you trust. Our commitment to manufacturing excellence ensures that your medical devices
get to market faster with uncompromising reliability and quality. Innovation is key to Integer's
growth as we continue to explore medtech's emerging markets.

[Read about our Markets][140]

## Cutting-edge Medical Device Technologies

We provide innovative, high quality medical device technologies - including catheters, guidewires,
introducers, delivery systems, tantalum capacitors, implantable ports, neuromodulation devices,
pacemaker batteries, implantable and external batteries, and much more – to meet customers’ needs
and help enhance the lives of patients worldwide. The products we design and manufacture range from
finished device systems to Class III Medical Devices and hundreds of components dispersed among more
than 15 markets. We also provide market-ready products to medical device OEMs. From product design
to completed systems, our expertise in medical device development and battery design is foundational
to the history of cardiac rhythm and cardio and vascular health.

[Learn about our Products][141]

## Proven by Manufacturing Excellence and Quality.

**Strengthen your innovation **with our rapid prototyping, design and development expertise, and

**Get to market faster **by utilizing our platform technologies and market-ready products that

## Global Innovative Medical Device Manufacturing and Design

During our 80-year legacy of cutting-edge medical device manufacturing and medical device
development, we have established a solid patient-focused foundation in cardiac rhythm, cardio and
vascular health, neuromodulation devices, and custom medical battery packs and chargers for global
OEMs. Integer is a world leader in advanced medical device design and outsourcing across four
continents. Our technology and manufactured components can be found in almost every global medical
device brand you trust. Our commitment to manufacturing excellence ensures that your medical devices
get to market faster with uncompromising reliability and quality. Innovation is key to Integer's
growth as we continue to explore medtech's emerging markets.

[Read about our Markets][140]

## Cutting-edge Medical Device Technologies

We provide innovative, high quality medical device technologies - including catheters, guidewires,
introducers, delivery systems, tantalum capacitors, implantable ports, neuromodulation devices,
pacemaker batteries, implantable and external batteries, and much more – to meet customers’ needs
and help enhance the lives of patients worldwide. The products we design and manufacture range from
finished device systems to Class III Medical Devices and hundreds of components dispersed among more
than 15 markets. We also provide market-ready products to medical device OEMs. From product design
to completed systems, our expertise in medical device development and battery design is foundational
to the history of cardiac rhythm and cardio and vascular health.

[Learn about our Products][141]

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate

  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# Right Where Care Begins

PolyPid is an innovative biopharmaceutical company dedicated to improving patient outcomes by
developing long-acting, controlled-release medicines that deliver therapy precisely at the site of
care, improving outcomes across surgical care, metabolic diseases, and beyond.

[ About Us ][24]

## Right Where Care Begins

PolyPid has entered an exclusive commercialization partnership with Azurity Pharmaceuticals for
D-PLEX₁₀₀ in the U.S. and Canada valued at over $320 million

[ Read the announcement ][25]

## Redefining the Surgical Standard

Our lead product, D-PLEX100, incorporates the proprietary Kynatrix™ technology and represents a
first-in-class incisional prophylactic therapy for the prevention of surgical site infections
(SSIs). It introduces long-awaited advancement in SSI prevention by enabling localized, prolonged
antibiotic exposure directly at the surgical incision.

By delivering concentrated, broad-spectrum antibiotics at the incision site for 30 days, the most
critical postoperative risk period. D-PLEX100 has demonstrated a clinically meaningful 60% reduction
in surgical site infections compared with standard of care.

[ Learn More about D-PLEX100 ][26]
[Icon & surgion]

## Constant and Consistent Drug Release

The Kynatrix™ technology enables customizable, localized, extended drug delivery over periods
ranging from days to weeks, without burst effects, ensuring linear, high-concentration exposure
across a broad range of therapeutic agents.

# Right Where Care Begins

PolyPid is an innovative biopharmaceutical company dedicated to improving patient outcomes by
developing long-acting, controlled-release medicines that deliver therapy precisely at the site of
care, improving outcomes across surgical care, metabolic diseases, and beyond.

[ About Us ][24]

## Right Where Care Begins

PolyPid has entered an exclusive commercialization partnership with Azurity Pharmaceuticals for
D-PLEX₁₀₀ in the U.S. and Canada valued at over $320 million

[ Read the announcement ][25]
[popup-icon]

#### X

## Redefining the Surgical Standard

Our lead product, D-PLEX100, incorporates the proprietary Kynatrix™ technology and represents a
first-in-class incisional prophylactic therapy for the prevention of surgical site infections
(SSIs). It introduces long-awaited advancement in SSI prevention by enabling localized, prolonged
antibiotic exposure directly at the surgical incision.

By delivering concentrated, broad-spectrum antibiotics at the incision site for 30 days, the most
critical postoperative risk period. D-PLEX100 has demonstrated a clinically meaningful 60% reduction
in surgical site infections compared with standard of care.

[ Learn More about D-PLEX100 ][26]
[Icon & surgion]

## Constant and Consistent Drug Release

The Kynatrix™ technology enables customizable, localized, extended drug delivery over periods
ranging from days to weeks, without burst effects, ensuring linear, high-concentration exposure
across a broad range of therapeutic agents.

### Product Range


#### Tablets

Pharmaceutical tablets are a widely used form of medication delivery in the healthcare industry.
These small, solid, and easily consumable pills are designed to contain specific active ingredients
that provide therapeutic effects. The content of these tablets can vary greatly depending on the
intended use of the medication.


#### Syrups

Pharmaceutical syrups play a crucial role in the healthcare industry, serving as a convenient and
effective way to deliver medications to patients. These liquid formulations are specially designed
to ensure accurate dosing and ease of administration, making them particularly suitable for
children, elderly individuals.


#### Ointment

Ointments are specialized semi-solid formulations applied to the skin or mucous membranes for
various therapeutic or protective purposes. At Richberg Healthcare Pvt. Ltd , we follow rigorous
manufacturing processes to ensure the highest quality in every batch of ointments produced.


#### Respules

"Respules" refers to a specific form of nebulizer medication, typically in a liquid-filled ampoule,
that is designed for inhalation to treat respiratory conditions like asthma or chronic obstructive
pulmonary disease (COPD). These are often produced by pharmaceutical companies specializing in
respiratory care and medications.


#### Capsules

Capsules are a widely used pharmaceutical dosage form, known for their convenience and effectiveness
in delivering medication to patients. These small, cylindrical containers consist of two halves,
typically made of gelatin or a suitable alternative material, that encase the active ingredients in
a precise and measured manner.


#### Injection

Injection manufacturing, particularly for pharmaceuticals, involves stringent processes to ensure
sterility, accuracy, and efficacy. Injectable medications are commonly used for rapid, controlled
delivery of drugs, and they require precise manufacturing steps due to their direct delivery into
the bloodstream, muscles, or tissues.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a

in India.

][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

### [2026 BIO International Convention In-Depth Analysis Report][17]

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

# Denken Sie über Zahlen hinaus!

Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Bereich, in dem die eigentliche Dynamik oft ihren Anfang nimmt: kleine
und mittelständische Innovatoren. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, die zugrunde liegenden Probleme der
Investoren aufzudecken, eine klare und umsetzbare Investorenlandkarte zu erstellen und Ihre
Geschichte auf den wichtigen Plattformen und Datenterminals zu positionieren. Durch gezielte,
marktspezifische Kontaktaufnahme in Europa, Nordamerika, APAC und LATAM stellen wir sicher, dass
Ihre Geschichte die Schreibtische erreicht, die aktiv die Kapitalströme beeinflussen.

[ Get Started ][32]
[VASRO GmbH - Invest with insight]

## Was wir tun

Wir helfen börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen dabei, die ihnen oft fehlende Sichtbarkeit
für Investoren zu erlangen. Wir identifizieren die zugrunde liegenden Lücken und teilen sie Ihnen
mit, wobei wir den Prozess auf Ihre Bedürfnisse zuschneiden. Auf dieser Grundlage erstellen wir eine
präzise Investorenübersicht, positionieren Ihre Geschichte auf führenden Plattformen und
Datenterminals und führen gezielte Kontaktaufnahmen mit den für Sie wichtigen Desks durch – und zwar
dort, wo Ihre Geschichte für sie von Bedeutung ist.

### Maximierung der Sichtbarkeit für Investoren

Finden Sie die richtigen Ansprechpartner, positionieren Sie Ihre Geschichte dort, wo Fachleute
tatsächlich arbeiten, und führen Sie gezielte Outreach-Maßnahmen mit disziplinierter Kadenz sowohl
für Privatanleger als auch für institutionelle Anleger durch.

### Analystenfertige Equity-Berichte

Branchenspezialist, unterzeichnungsfähige Thesen, die auf einem klaren Modell, definierten Risiken,
Katalysatoren und einem praktischen Umsetzungsplan basieren.

### Schließen die Einzelhandelsforschung Lücke Gap

Verwandeln Sie Ihre Eigenkapitalberichte in kurze, neutrale Updates und veröffentlichen Sie diese
nach Bedarf auf den Kanälen, die private Investoren bereits nutzen.

Klare Botschaften, die die Entdeckung stärken, sinnvolle Folgemaßnahmen fördern und eine höhere
Qualität der Eigentümerschaft unterstützen.

Priorisierung des Kundenerfolgs durch relevante und wirkungsvolle Erkenntnisse.

Wir stärken die Sichtbarkeit durch die Positionierung Ihrer Erzählung dort, wo Ihr Publikum sie

## Dauerhafte Kooperationen

Aufbau dauerhafter, kooperativer und vertrauensvoller Partnerschaften.

## Wer Wir arbeiten zusammen mit

Wir arbeiten mit börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen zusammen, die eine präzisere und
gezieltere Aktienabdeckung anstreben. Unser Tätigkeitsbereich erstreckt sich über Europa,
Nordamerika, den asiatisch-pazifischen Raum und ausgewählte lateinamerikanische Märkte, wodurch wir
eine global einheitliche Sichtbarkeitsstrategie anstelle fragmentierter regionaler Bemühungen
gewährleisten. Wir sind in allen wichtigen Branchen tätig und verfügen über eine besondere
Spezialisierung in Bereichen, in denen die Erwartungen der Anleger und die technischen Anforderungen
besonders hoch sind, darunter Pharma/Biotech, Technologie, Energie, Informationstechnologie und
angrenzende Industriesegmente. Diese Kombination ermöglicht es uns, die Geschichte jedes Emittenten
mit branchenrelevanter Präzision zu positionieren und gleichzeitig sicherzustellen, dass sie die
Desks und Regionen erreicht, in denen die Kapitalbildung tatsächlich stattfindet.

# Denken Sie über Zahlen hinaus!

Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Bereich, in dem die eigentliche Dynamik oft ihren Anfang nimmt: kleine
und mittelständische Innovatoren. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, die zugrunde liegenden Probleme der
Investoren aufzudecken, eine klare und umsetzbare Investorenlandkarte zu erstellen und Ihre
Geschichte auf den wichtigen Plattformen und Datenterminals zu positionieren. Durch gezielte,
marktspezifische Kontaktaufnahme in Europa, Nordamerika, APAC und LATAM stellen wir sicher, dass
Ihre Geschichte die Schreibtische erreicht, die aktiv die Kapitalströme beeinflussen.

Wir helfen börsennotierten Small- und Mid-Cap-Unternehmen dabei, die ihnen oft fehlende Sichtbarkeit

Datenterminals und führen gezielte Kontaktaufnahmen mit den für Sie wichtigen Desks durch – und zwar

# Drug and Biologic Delivery Systems

### Delivery device technology with a “patient-centric” focus.

We provide patient-centric delivery device technology and primary container packaging for
pharmaceutical, biotech and personal care companies worldwide. We combine novel technology and
technical services to provide solutions to challenging drug, biopharmaceutical, biologic or
botanical delivery applications tailored to meet your technical specifications and market
requirements. We utilize a technology platform approach in combination with technical services to
provide custom configured packaging and delivery systems for liquid, powder and reconstituted powder
formulations. Delivery systems for ophthalmic, systemic intranasal, nose to brain, sublingual,
buccal, and otic, routes of administration are available.

## [Routes of Drug Delivery][22]

We offer delivery device configurations for the following routes of administration

[][23]

### Ophthalmic

[][24]

### Intranasal

[][25]

### Nose to  Brain

[][26]

### Sublingual

[][27]

### Animal Care

## Analytical Services

Services include:
* Dispense Characterization via laser diffraction
* Dispense Plume Morphology via high speed video
* Aerodynamic Deposition (in-vitro upper and lower respiratory tracks)
* Delivered Dose Uniformity and Consistency
* Emitted Dose (shot weight/mass transfer)
* Size Exclusion Chromatography

## Pre-Commercial Services

Services include:
* combination product primary container/dispenser configuration and optimization
* prototype configuration and supply
* analytical testing (devices, primary containers, dispense characteristics)
* process engineering (fill process manufacturing)
* pre-clinical and clinical supply
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation

## Commercial Services

Services include:
* commercial technology transfer
* commercial scale up
* DMF, quality and regulatory documentation
* commercial supply
* capital equipment supply and siting
* technology licensing 

[Learn More][28]
[Learn More][29]
[Learn More][30]

## Technology Platforms

Our ZTECH-L™ Delivery Platform is designed to package and deliver liquid drugs, biopharmaceuticals,
biologics and botanicals, while the ZTECH-P™ Delivery Platform is designed for powders or
reconstituted powder to liquid drug/device combination product applications.

[Technology Platforms][31]
[Devices][32]
[Primary Containers][33]

## Biosecurity

Zeteo Biomedical’s ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ drug and biologic delivery platforms provide solutions to
package and administer vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures for infectious diseases
and bio-terror threats.  ZTECH-L™ and ZTECH-P™ nasal and sublingual delivery devices are readily
adaptable to public health needs, including rapid manufacturing and deployment to support both self
or caregiver administration options for vaccines, anti-virals and biomedical countermeasures across
large populations under crisis conditions.

[Learn More][34]

## **Applied Innovation**

Zeteo’s novel drug delivery systems require no priming. We provide consistent, precise dosing and
efficient unit dose packaging to reduce the cost per dose. Devices are available in mono-dose and
multi-dose configurations. The dose counter keeps track of administration, reducing dosing errors
and increasing adherence. The devices are compact, easily carried in a purse or pocket and, with a
small learning curve, enable patient simple self-administration. Our commercially scalable Form Fill
Seal packaging technology supports both non-sterile and aseptic fill processes.

[Learn more][35]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
